basics.name: environmentNameControl
basics.label: Environment name
basics.toolTip: A short name used to derive the names of the resources this template creates (e.g. "scope-demo"). Lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens only, 3-20 characters.

constraints.validationMessage: Use 3-20 lowercase alphanumeric characters or hyphens.

elements.name: kubernetesVersionControl
elements.label: Kubernetes version
elements.toolTip: Leave empty to use the AKS default version.

elements.name: systemNodeVmSizeControl
elements.label: System node pool VM size
elements.toolTip: VM size used for the AKS System node pool. Defaults to a modest, broadly-available general-purpose size (Dsv5); choose a larger size for production.

elements.name: systemNodeCountControl
elements.label: System node pool count
elements.toolTip: Number of nodes in the System node pool. Defaults to 1 for a minimal/dev footprint; use 3+ for production HA.

elements.name: userNodeVmSizeControl
elements.label: User node pool VM size
elements.toolTip: VM size used for the AKS User node pool. Defaults to a modest, broadly-available general-purpose size (Dsv5); choose a larger size for production.

elements.name: userNodeCountControl
elements.label: User node pool count
elements.toolTip: Number of nodes in the User node pool. Defaults to 2 to leave CPU headroom for an optional ACP worker pod alongside the core app; scale up further for production workloads.

elements.name: acrSkuControl
elements.label: Container registry SKU
elements.toolTip: SKU for the Azure Container Registry that hosts the worker image. Basic is sufficient for a single small image and does not consume compute quota.

elements.name: cosmosConsistencyControl
elements.label: Cosmos DB consistency level
elements.toolTip: Default consistency level for the Cosmos DB (MongoDB API) account.

elements.name: redisSkuControl
elements.label: Redis cache SKU
elements.toolTip: SKU for Azure Managed Redis (Balanced tier). Capacity is encoded in the SKU name itself. Defaults to the smallest size to minimize regional capacity/quota pressure.

elements.name: redisHighAvailabilityControl
elements.label: Redis high availability
elements.toolTip: Data replication for high availability on Azure Managed Redis. Disabled roughly halves the underlying allocation and reduces the odds of regional InsufficientCapacity errors - recommended for a quickstart/dev deployment. Enable for production.

elements.name: storageSkuControl
elements.label: Storage account SKU
elements.toolTip: Replication SKU for the storage account (blob + queue).

elements.name: vnetAddressPrefixControl
elements.label: Virtual network address space (CIDR)
elements.toolTip: Address space for the virtual network.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid CIDR range, e.g. 10.20.0.0/16.

elements.name: aksSubnetPrefixControl
elements.label: AKS node subnet address prefix (CIDR)
elements.toolTip: Address prefix for the AKS node subnet. Must be contained within the virtual network address space.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid CIDR range, e.g. 10.20.0.0/20.

elements.name: privateEndpointSubnetPrefixControl
elements.label: Private endpoints subnet address prefix (CIDR)
elements.toolTip: Address prefix for the subnet used by private endpoints (Key Vault, Cosmos DB, Redis, Storage). Must be contained within the virtual network address space.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid CIDR range, e.g. 10.20.16.0/24.

elements.name: workloadIdentityNamespaceControl
elements.label: Kubernetes service account namespace
elements.toolTip: Kubernetes namespace of the service account that will use workload identity to access Azure resources (Key Vault, Storage).

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid Kubernetes namespace name.

elements.name: workloadIdentityServiceAccountControl
elements.label: Kubernetes service account name
elements.toolTip: Name of the Kubernetes service account that will be federated with the workload identity.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid Kubernetes service account name.

elements.name: workerWorkloadIdentityNamespaceControl
elements.label: Worker Kubernetes service account namespace
elements.toolTip: Kubernetes namespace of the ACP worker service account. Workers get a separate, lower-privilege workload identity (Storage data-plane access only, no Key Vault access) since they run benchmark-controlled agent code.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid Kubernetes namespace name.

elements.name: workerWorkloadIdentityServiceAccountControl
elements.label: Worker Kubernetes service account name
elements.toolTip: Name of the Kubernetes service account that will be federated with the worker workload identity.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid Kubernetes service account name.
